<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head><style>
@font-face {
  font-family: "Optimistic";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 400 600;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/fonts/OptimisticAI_VF_Optimized.woff2") format("woff2");
}
@font-face {
  font-family: "Optimistic Mono";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/fonts/OptimisticMono_W_TextRegular.woff2") format("woff2");
}
:where(html) {
  font-family: "Optimistic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
:where(code, pre, kbd, samp) {
  font-family: "Optimistic Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
}
</style><style data-metaai-safe-area>:root { scroll-padding-top: var(--safe-area-scroll-padding-top, 0px); }

  background: inherit;
  content: "";
  height: var(--safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
  inset: 0 0 auto;
  pointer-events: none;
  position: fixed;

}
</style><script data-metaai-safe-area-runtime>// (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates. Confidential and proprietary.

(() => {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const rawInset = params.get('top_inset_px');
  const parsedInset = rawInset !== null && /^\d+$/.test(rawInset)
    ? Number(rawInset)
    : 0;
  const topInset = params.get('has_top_banner') === '1'
    ? Math.min(parsedInset, 256)
    : 0;
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-top', `${topInset}px`);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${topInset}px`);

  function observeNavigation() {
    const root = document.getElementById('root');
    if (root === null) return;
    const observed = new Set();
    let scheduled = false;

    function syncScrollPadding() {
      const elements = new Set(root.querySelectorAll('[data-safe-area-sticky-top]'));
      for (const element of observed) {
        if (!elements.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.unobserve(element);
          observed.delete(element);
        }
      }
      for (const element of elements) {
        if (!observed.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.observe(element);
          observed.add(element);
        }
      }
      let padding = topInset;
      for (const element of elements) {
        const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
        if (style.position !== 'sticky' && style.position !== 'fixed') continue;
        const top = Number.parseFloat(style.top);
        if (Number.isFinite(top)) {
          padding = Math.max(padding, top + element.getBoundingClientRect().height);
        }
      }
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${Math.ceil(padding)}px`,
      );
    }

    function scheduleUpdate() {
      if (scheduled) return;
      scheduled = true;
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        scheduled = false;
        syncScrollPadding();
      });
    }

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(scheduleUpdate);
    const mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(scheduleUpdate);
    mutationObserver.observe(root, {
      attributeFilter: ['class', 'data-safe-area-sticky-top', 'hidden', 'style'],
      attributes: true,
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
    });
    window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleUpdate);
    scheduleUpdate();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', observeNavigation, {once: true});
  } else {
    observeNavigation();
  }
})();

// When the records API rejects a write because the app is at its record
// limit, this page answers the next writes itself with the same rejection.
// The answers come after a delay, under an exponential backoff, and one probe
// write goes to the network per backoff window. A new record that the API
// accepts, or a delete that removes a record, ends the backoff. The backoff
// also ends when a write comes 60 s or more after the last window, and no probe
// from the last 60 s is in flight. The state is in memory only.
//
// The compiled-HTML contract checks (`stateful_crud_contract.rs` and
// `stateful_hosted_release.rs`) read this file as part of the app. So it must
// not contain a quoted records action, a browser storage API, the JSON request
// header or encoder, a quoted POST method, a collection argument, or a name
// bound to a quoted word. It must also not call a network function with a
// quoted URL.
(() => {
  const nativeFetch = window.fetch;
  if (typeof nativeFetch !== 'function') return;
  const NativeRequest = window.Request;
  const NativeResponse = window.Response;
  const NativeURL = window.URL;
  const NativePromise = window.Promise;
  const parseJson = JSON.parse;
  const reflectApply = Reflect.apply;
  const startTimer = window.setTimeout.bind(window);
  const stopTimer = window.clearTimeout.bind(window);
  const monotonicNow = window.performance.now.bind(window.performance);

  const CAPACITY_STATUS = 409;
  const CAPACITY_BODY = '{"error":"artifact record limit reached"}';
  const FIRST_WINDOW_MS = 1000;
  const MAX_WINDOW_MS = 60000;
  const LOCAL_ANSWER_DELAY_MS = 500;
  const MAX_TRACKED_RECORDS = 2048;
  const actionName = operation => ['records', operation].join('.');
  const CREATE = actionName('create');
  const PUT = actionName('put');
  const GET = actionName('get');
  const LIST = actionName('list');
  const DELETE = actionName('delete');
  const OBSERVED_ACTIONS = [CREATE, PUT, GET, LIST, DELETE];
  const POST_METHOD = ['PO', 'ST'].join('');
  const LOCAL_HEADERS = [
    [['content', 'type'].join('-'), ['application', 'json'].join('/') + '; charset=utf-8'],
    ['cache-control', 'no-store'],
    ['x-metaai-records-guard', 'capacity'],
  ];

  // that was sent in an earlier epoch does not change the window, so the writes
  // that were in flight when the limit was reached count as one rejection.
  let streak = 0;
  let windowEndsAt = 0;
  let epoch = 0;
  let activeProbe = null;
  const knownIds = new Set();
  const knownKeys = new Map();

  function recordKey(collection, value) {
    return `${collection}\n${value}`;
  }

  function rememberId(collection, id) {
    if (typeof id !== 'string') return;
    const key = recordKey(collection, id);
    knownIds.delete(key);
    knownIds.add(key);

  }

  // keeps the id that an earlier answer saved.

    knownKeys.delete(key);
    knownKeys.set(key, id);
    if (knownKeys.size > MAX_TRACKED_RECORDS) knownKeys.delete(knownKeys.keys().next().value);
  }

    knownIds.delete(savedId);
    for (const [idempotencyKey, keySavedId] of knownKeys) {

    return input instanceof NativeRequest ? input.clone().text() : null;

    return input instanceof NativeRequest ? input.signal : null;

    if (time < windowEndsAt) return true;
    return activeProbe !== null && time - activeProbe.startedAt < MAX_WINDOW_MS;
  }

    streak += 1;

    epoch += 1;

    streak = 0;
    windowEndsAt = 0;
    activeProbe = null;

  function answerLocally(signal) {

  }

  function handle(action, send, signal) {
    if (action === null) return send();
    const sent = {epoch, mayStillSucceed: false, probe: null};
    if (isWrite(action)) {
      sent.mayStillSucceed = mayStillSucceed(action);
      if (streak > 0 && !sent.mayStillSucceed) {

    const self = this;
    const args = arguments;
    const send = () => reflectApply(nativeFetch, self, args);

    let signal;
    try {
      if (!targetsActions(input, init)) return send();

    window.fetch = guardedFetch;
  } catch {

  }

:root{
  --bg:#04120A;
  --surface:#071E12;
  --surface-2:#0A2A1A;
  --line:#1D4A30;
  --neon:#00FF88;
  --gold:#FFC107;
  --blue:#38BDF8;
  --text:#F2FFF7;
  --muted:#A9C6B4;
  --card:rgba(10,38,24,.82);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root{
    --bg:#030F08;
    --surface:#061B10;
  }
}

*{
  box-sizing:border-box;
}

html{
  scroll-behavior:smooth;
}

body{
  margin:0;
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif;
}

.font-display{
  font-family:'Oswald','Archivo',sans-serif;
}

.glass{
  background:var(--card);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border:1px solid rgba(0,255,136,.22);
}

.glow{
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,255,136,.2), 0 18px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 0 42px rgba(0,255,136,.12);
}

.text-stroke{
  -webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(0,255,136,.55);
  color:transparent;
}

.tilt{
  transition:transform .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease;
  transform-style:preserve-3d;
}

.tilt:hover{
  transform:translateY(-7px) rotateX(4deg) rotateY(-4deg);
  box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 0 0 35px rgba(0,255,136,.18);
}

@keyframes marquee{
  from{
    transform:translateX(0)
  }

  to{
    transform:translateX(-50%)
  }
}

@keyframes floatY{
  0%,100%{
    transform:translateY(0) rotate(-3deg)
  }

  50%{
    transform:translateY(-16px) rotate(4deg)
  }
}

@keyframes ballSpin{
  from{
    transform:rotate(0deg)
  }

  to{
    transform:rotate(360deg)
  }
}

@keyframes ballBounce{
  0%,100%{
    transform:translateY(0) scale(1.05,.95)
  }

  50%{
    transform:translateY(-58px) scale(.96,1.04)
  }
}

@keyframes pulseDot{
  0%,100%{
    transform:scale(1);
    opacity:1
  }

  50%{
    transform:scale(1.7);
    opacity:.35
  }
}

@keyframes crowd{
  0%,100%{
    opacity:.25;
    transform:scale(1)
  }

  50%{
    opacity:.65;
    transform:scale(1.08)
  }
}

@keyframes confetti{
  0%{
    transform:translateY(-20px) rotate(0)
  }

  100%{
    transform:translateY(360px) rotate(540deg)
  }
}

@keyframes gradientMove{
  0%,100%{
    background-position:0% 50%
  }

  50%{
    background-position:100% 50%
  }
}

@keyframes eq{
  0%,100%{
    height:8px
  }

  50%{
    height:26px
  }
}

@keyframes shine{
  from{
    transform:translateX(-100%)
  }

  to{
    transform:translateX(220%)
  }
}

@keyframes slideInTop{
  from{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(-14px) scale(.98)
  }

  to{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0) scale(1)
  }
}

@keyframes liveGlow{
  0%,100%{
    box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(220,38,38,.55)
  }

  50%{
    box-shadow:0 0 22px 4px rgba(220,38,38,.45)
  }
}

@keyframes toastIn{
  from{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(18px)
  }

  to{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0)
  }
}

.animate-slide-in{
  animation:slideInTop .45s ease both;
}

.animate-live-glow{
  animation:liveGlow 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-toast-in{
  animation:toastIn .35s ease both;
}

.animate-marquee{
  animation:marquee 26s linear infinite;
}

.animate-float{
  animation:floatY 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-ball{
  animation:ballSpin 7s linear infinite;
}

.animate-bounce-ball{
  animation:ballBounce 1.35s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-pulse-dot{
  animation:pulseDot 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-crowd{
  animation:crowd 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-gradient{
  background-size:220% 220%;
  animation:gradientMove 8s ease infinite;
}

.shine{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}

.shine:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  width:45%;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.18),transparent);
  animation:shine 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

input,select,textarea,button{
  font:inherit;
}

button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible{
  outline:3px solid var(--gold);
  outline-offset:2px;
}

.range{
  accent-color:var(--neon);
}

.seam{
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 0 8px, rgba(255,255,255,.85) 9px 11px, transparent 12px 20px);
}

.placeholder\:text-white\/40::-moz-placeholder{
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.4);
}

.placeholder\:text-white\/40::placeholder{
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.4);
}

.hover\:scale-105:hover{
  --tw-scale-x: 1.05;
  --tw-scale-y: 1.05;
  transform: translate(var(--tw-translate-x), var(--tw-translate-y)) rotate(var(--tw-rotate)) skewX(var(--tw-skew-x)) skewY(var(--tw-skew-y)) scaleX(var(--tw-scale-x)) scaleY(var(--tw-scale-y));
}

.hover\:scale-110:hover{
  --tw-scale-x: 1.1;
  --tw-scale-y: 1.1;
  transform: translate(var(--tw-translate-x), var(--tw-translate-y)) rotate(var(--tw-rotate)) skewX(var(--tw-skew-x)) skewY(var(--tw-skew-y)) scaleX(var(--tw-scale-x)) scaleY(var(--tw-scale-y));
}

.hover\:border-\[\#00FF88\]:hover{
  --tw-border-opacity: 1;
  border-color: rgb(0 255 136 / var(--tw-border-opacity, 1));
}

.hover\:border-red-400:hover{
  --tw-border-opacity: 1;
  border-color: rgb(248 113 113 / var(--tw-border-opacity, 1));
}

.hover\:bg-white\/10:hover{
  background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1);
}

.hover\:bg-white\/5:hover{
  background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05);
}

.hover\:text-\[\#00FF88\]:hover{
  --tw-text-opacity: 1;
  color: rgb(0 255 136 / var(--tw-text-opacity, 1));
}

.disabled\:opacity-60:disabled{
  opacity: 0.6;
}

@media (min-width: 640px){
  .sm\:order-2{
    order: 2;
  }

  .sm\:order-3{
    order: 3;
  }

  .sm\:ml-auto{
    margin-left: auto;
  }

  .sm\:block{
    display: block;
  }

  .sm\:w-auto{
    width: auto;
  }

  .sm\:flex-1{
    flex: 1 1 0%;
  }

  .sm\:grid-cols-2{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .sm\:grid-cols-\[1fr_2fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
  }

  .sm\:grid-cols-\[3rem_1fr_5rem_6rem_5rem\]{
    grid-template-columns: 3rem 1fr 5rem 6rem 5rem;
  }

  .sm\:flex-row{
    flex-direction: row;
  }

  .sm\:flex-wrap{
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .sm\:items-center{
    align-items: center;
  }

  .sm\:justify-center{
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .sm\:gap-2{
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:self-auto{
    align-self: auto;
  }

  .sm\:p-10{
    padding: 2.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:p-6{
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:px-3{
    padding-left: 0.75rem;
    padding-right: 0.75rem;
  }

  .sm\:px-5{
    padding-left: 1.25rem;
    padding-right: 1.25rem;
  }

  .sm\:px-6{
    padding-left: 1.5rem;
    padding-right: 1.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-2xl{
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    line-height: 2rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-3xl{
    font-size: 1.875rem;
    line-height: 2.25rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-5xl{
    font-size: 3rem;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .sm\:text-\[13px\]{
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .sm\:text-base{
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-sm{
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1.25rem;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 768px){
  .md\:block{
    display: block;
  }

  .md\:flex{
    display: flex;
  }

  .md\:hidden{
    display: none;
  }

  .md\:grid-cols-3{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (min-width: 1024px){
  .lg\:grid-cols-3{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-4{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-\[1\.2fr_\.8fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1.2fr .8fr;
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-\[1\.55fr_\.85fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1.55fr .85fr;
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-\[1fr_1\.2fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr;
  }

  .lg\:py-10{
    padding-top: 2.5rem;
    padding-bottom: 2.5rem;
  }
}

(() => {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const rawInset = params.get('top_inset_px');
  const parsedInset = rawInset !== null && /^\d+$/.test(rawInset)
    ? Number(rawInset)
    : 0;
  const topInset = params.get('has_top_banner') === '1'
    ? Math.min(parsedInset, 256)
    : 0;
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-top', `${topInset}px`);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${topInset}px`);

  function observeNavigation() {
    const root = document.getElementById('root');
    if (root === null) return;
    const observed = new Set();
    let scheduled = false;

    function syncScrollPadding() {
      const elements = new Set(root.querySelectorAll('[data-safe-area-sticky-top]'));
      for (const element of observed) {
        if (!elements.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.unobserve(element);
          observed.delete(element);
        }
      }
      for (const element of elements) {
        if (!observed.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.observe(element);
          observed.add(element);
        }
      }
      let padding = topInset;
      for (const element of elements) {
        const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
        if (style.position !== 'sticky' && style.position !== 'fixed') continue;
        const top = Number.parseFloat(style.top);
        if (Number.isFinite(top)) {
          padding = Math.max(padding, top + element.getBoundingClientRect().height);
        }
      }
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${Math.ceil(padding)}px`,
      );
    }

    function scheduleUpdate() {
      if (scheduled) return;
      scheduled = true;
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        scheduled = false;
        syncScrollPadding();
      });
    }

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(scheduleUpdate);
    const mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(scheduleUpdate);
    mutationObserver.observe(root, {
      attributeFilter: ['class', 'data-safe-area-sticky-top', 'hidden', 'style'],
      attributes: true,
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
    });
    window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleUpdate);
    scheduleUpdate();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', observeNavigation, {once: true});
  } else {
    observeNavigation();
  }
})();

/*
1. Prevent padding and border from affecting element width. (https://github.com/mozdevs/cssremedy/issues/4)
2. Allow adding a border to an element by just adding a border-width. (https://github.com/tailwindcss/tailwindcss/pull/116)
*/

*,
::before,
::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  /* 1 */
  border-width: 0;
  /* 2 */
  border-style: solid;
  /* 2 */
  border-color: #e5e7eb;
  /* 2 */
}

::before,
::after {
  --tw-content: '';
}

/*
1. Use a consistent sensible line-height in all browsers.
2. Prevent adjustments of font size after orientation changes in iOS.
3. Use a more readable tab size.
4. Use the user's configured `sans` font-family by default.
5. Use the user's configured `sans` font-feature-settings by default.
6. Use the user's configured `sans` font-variation-settings by default.

html,
:host {
  line-height: 1.5;
  /* 1 */
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  /* 2 */
  -moz-tab-size: 4;
  /* 3 */
  -o-tab-size: 4;
     tab-size: 4;
  /* 3 */
  font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji";
  /* 4 */
  font-feature-settings: normal;
  /* 5 */
  font-variation-settings: normal;
  /* 6 */
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  /* 7 */
}

/*
1. Remove the margin in all browsers.
2. Inherit line-height from `html` so users can set them as a class directly on the `html` element.
*/

body {

  /* 1 */
  line-height: inherit;
  /* 2 */
}

/*
1. Add the correct height in Firefox.
2. Correct the inheritance of border color in Firefox. (https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=190655)

}

.transition-colors{

:root{
  --bg:#04120A;
  --surface:#071E12;
  --surface-2:#0A2A1A;
  --line:#1D4A30;
  --neon:#00FF88;
  --gold:#FFC107;
  --blue:#38BDF8;
  --text:#F2FFF7;
  --muted:#A9C6B4;
  --card:rgba(10,38,24,.82);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root{
    --bg:#030F08;
    --surface:#061B10;
  }
}

*{
  box-sizing:border-box;
}

html{
  scroll-behavior:smooth;
}

body{
  margin:0;
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif;
}

.font-display{
  font-family:'Oswald','Archivo',sans-serif;
}

.glass{
  background:var(--card);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border:1px solid rgba(0,255,136,.22);
}

.glow{
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,255,136,.2), 0 18px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 0 42px rgba(0,255,136,.12);
}

.text-stroke{
  -webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(0,255,136,.55);
  color:transparent;
}

.tilt{
  transition:transform .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease;
  transform-style:preserve-3d;
}

.tilt:hover{
  transform:translateY(-7px) rotateX(4deg) rotateY(-4deg);
  box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 0 0 35px rgba(0,255,136,.18);
}

@keyframes marquee{
  from{
    transform:translateX(0)
  }

  to{
    transform:translateX(-50%)
  }
}

@keyframes floatY{
  0%,100%{
    transform:translateY(0) rotate(-3deg)
  }

  50%{
    transform:translateY(-16px) rotate(4deg)
  }
}

@keyframes ballSpin{
  from{
    transform:rotate(0deg)
  }

  to{
    transform:rotate(360deg)
  }
}

@keyframes ballBounce{
  0%,100%{
    transform:translateY(0) scale(1.05,.95)
  }

  50%{
    transform:translateY(-58px) scale(.96,1.04)
  }
}

@keyframes pulseDot{
  0%,100%{
    transform:scale(1);
    opacity:1
  }

  50%{
    transform:scale(1.7);
    opacity:.35
  }
}

@keyframes crowd{
  0%,100%{
    opacity:.25;
    transform:scale(1)
  }

  50%{
    opacity:.65;
    transform:scale(1.08)
  }
}

@keyframes confetti{
  0%{
    transform:translateY(-20px) rotate(0)
  }

  100%{
    transform:translateY(360px) rotate(540deg)
  }
}

@keyframes gradientMove{
  0%,100%{
    background-position:0% 50%
  }

  50%{
    background-position:100% 50%
  }
}

@keyframes eq{
  0%,100%{
    height:8px
  }

  50%{
    height:26px
  }
}

@keyframes shine{
  from{
    transform:translateX(-100%)
  }

  to{
    transform:translateX(220%)
  }
}

@keyframes slideInTop{
  from{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(-14px) scale(.98)
  }

  to{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0) scale(1)
  }
}

@keyframes liveGlow{
  0%,100%{
    box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(220,38,38,.55)
  }

  50%{
    box-shadow:0 0 22px 4px rgba(220,38,38,.45)
  }
}

@keyframes toastIn{
  from{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(18px)
  }

  to{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0)
  }
}

.animate-slide-in{
  animation:slideInTop .45s ease both;
}

.animate-live-glow{
  animation:liveGlow 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-toast-in{
  animation:toastIn .35s ease both;
}

.animate-marquee{
  animation:marquee 26s linear infinite;
}

.animate-float{
  animation:floatY 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-ball{
  animation:ballSpin 7s linear infinite;
}

.animate-bounce-ball{
  animation:ballBounce 1.35s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-pulse-dot{
  animation:pulseDot 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-crowd{
  animation:crowd 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-gradient{
  background-size:220% 220%;
  animation:gradientMove 8s ease infinite;
}

.shine{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}

.shine:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  width:45%;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.18),transparent);
  animation:shine 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

input,select,textarea,button{
  font:inherit;
}

button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible{
  outline:3px solid var(--gold);
  outline-offset:2px;
}

.range{
  accent-color:var(--neon);
}

.seam{
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 0 8px, rgba(255,255,255,.85) 9px 11px, transparent 12px 20px);
}

.placeholder\:text-white\/40::-moz-placeholder{
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.4);
}

.placeholder\:text-white\/40::placeholder{
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.4);
}

.hover\:scale-105:hover{
  --tw-scale-x: 1.05;
  --tw-scale-y: 1.05;
  transform: translate(var(--tw-translate-x), var(--tw-translate-y)) rotate(var(--tw-rotate)) skewX(var(--tw-skew-x)) skewY(var(--tw-skew-y)) scaleX(var(--tw-scale-x)) scaleY(var(--tw-scale-y));
}

.hover\:scale-110:hover{
  --tw-scale-x: 1.1;
  --tw-scale-y: 1.1;
  transform: translate(var(--tw-translate-x), var(--tw-translate-y)) rotate(var(--tw-rotate)) skewX(var(--tw-skew-x)) skewY(var(--tw-skew-y)) scaleX(var(--tw-scale-x)) scaleY(var(--tw-scale-y));
}

.hover\:border-\[\#00FF88\]:hover{
  --tw-border-opacity: 1;
  border-color: rgb(0 255 136 / var(--tw-border-opacity, 1));
}

.hover\:border-red-400:hover{
  --tw-border-opacity: 1;
  border-color: rgb(248 113 113 / var(--tw-border-opacity, 1));
}

.hover\:bg-white\/10:hover{
  background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1);
}

.hover\:bg-white\/5:hover{
  background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05);
}

.hover\:text-\[\#00FF88\]:hover{
  --tw-text-opacity: 1;
  color: rgb(0 255 136 / var(--tw-text-opacity, 1));
}

.disabled\:opacity-60:disabled{
  opacity: 0.6;
}

@media (min-width: 640px){
  .sm\:order-2{
    order: 2;
  }

  .sm\:order-3{
    order: 3;
  }

  .sm\:ml-auto{
    margin-left: auto;
  }

  .sm\:block{
    display: block;
  }

  .sm\:w-auto{
    width: auto;
  }

  .sm\:flex-1{
    flex: 1 1 0%;
  }

  .sm\:grid-cols-2{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .sm\:grid-cols-\[1fr_2fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
  }

  .sm\:grid-cols-\[3rem_1fr_5rem_6rem_5rem\]{
    grid-template-columns: 3rem 1fr 5rem 6rem 5rem;
  }

  .sm\:flex-row{
    flex-direction: row;
  }

  .sm\:flex-wrap{
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .sm\:items-center{
    align-items: center;
  }

  .sm\:justify-center{
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .sm\:gap-2{
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:self-auto{
    align-self: auto;
  }

  .sm\:p-10{
    padding: 2.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:p-6{
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:px-3{
    padding-left: 0.75rem;
    padding-right: 0.75rem;
  }

  .sm\:px-5{
    padding-left: 1.25rem;
    padding-right: 1.25rem;
  }

  .sm\:px-6{
    padding-left: 1.5rem;
    padding-right: 1.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-2xl{
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    line-height: 2rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-3xl{
    font-size: 1.875rem;
    line-height: 2.25rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-5xl{
    font-size: 3rem;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .sm\:text-\[13px\]{
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .sm\:text-base{
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-sm{
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1.25rem;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 768px){
  .md\:block{
    display: block;
  }

  .md\:flex{
    display: flex;
  }

  .md\:hidden{
    display: none;
  }

  .md\:grid-cols-3{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (min-width: 1024px){
  .lg\:grid-cols-3{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-4{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-\[1\.2fr_\.8fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1.2fr .8fr;
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-\[1\.55fr_\.85fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1.55fr .85fr;
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-\[1fr_1\.2fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr;
  }

  .lg\:py-10{
    padding-top: 2.5rem;
    padding-bottom: 2.5rem;
  }
}

  const rawInset = params.get('top_inset_px');

    ? Number(rawInset)

  const topInset = params.get('has_top_banner') === '1'
    ? Math.min(parsedInset, 256)

  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-top', `${topInset}px`);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${topInset}px`);

  function observeNavigation() {
    const root = document.getElementById('root');
    if (root === null) return;
    const observed = new Set();
    let scheduled = false;

    function syncScrollPadding() {
      const elements = new Set(root.querySelectorAll('[data-safe-area-sticky-top]'));
      for (const element of observed) {
        if (!elements.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.unobserve(element);
          observed.delete(element);
        }
      }
      for (const element of elements) {
        if (!observed.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.observe(element);
          observed.add(element);
        }
      }
      let padding = topInset;
      for (const element of elements) {
        const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
        if (style.position !== 'sticky' && style.position !== 'fixed') continue;
        const top = Number.parseFloat(style.top);
        if (Number.isFinite(top)) {

        '--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${Math.ceil(padding)}px`,

      queueMicrotask(() => {

        syncScrollPadding();

      attributeFilter: ['class', 'data-safe-area-sticky-top', 'hidden', 'style'],

:root{
  --bg:#04120A;
  --surface:#071E12;
  --surface-2:#0A2A1A;
  --line:#1D4A30;
  --neon:#00FF88;
  --gold:#FFC107;
  --blue:#38BDF8;
  --text:#F2FFF7;
  --muted:#A9C6B4;
  --card:rgba(10,38,24,.82);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root{
    --bg:#030F08;
    --surface:#061B10;
  }
}

*{
  box-sizing:border-box;
}

html{
  scroll-behavior:smooth;
}

body{
  margin:0;
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif;
}

.font-display{
  font-family:'Oswald','Archivo',sans-serif;
}

.glass{
  background:var(--card);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border:1px solid rgba(0,255,136,.22);
}

.glow{
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,255,136,.2), 0 18px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 0 42px rgba(0,255,136,.12);
}

.text-stroke{
  -webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(0,255,136,.55);
  color:transparent;
}

.tilt{
  transition:transform .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease;
  transform-style:preserve-3d;
}

.tilt:hover{
  transform:translateY(-7px) rotateX(4deg) rotateY(-4deg);
  box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 0 0 35px rgba(0,255,136,.18);
}

@keyframes marquee{
  from{
    transform:translateX(0)
  }

  to{
    transform:translateX(-50%)
  }
}

@keyframes floatY{
  0%,100%{
    transform:translateY(0) rotate(-3deg)
  }

  50%{
    transform:translateY(-16px) rotate(4deg)
  }
}

@keyframes ballSpin{
  from{
    transform:rotate(0deg)
  }

  to{
    transform:rotate(360deg)
  }
}

@keyframes ballBounce{
  0%,100%{
    transform:translateY(0) scale(1.05,.95)
  }

  50%{
    transform:translateY(-58px) scale(.96,1.04)
  }
}

@keyframes pulseDot{
  0%,100%{
    transform:scale(1);
    opacity:1
  }

  50%{
    transform:scale(1.7);
    opacity:.35
  }
}

@keyframes crowd{
  0%,100%{
    opacity:.25;
    transform:scale(1)
  }

  50%{
    opacity:.65;
    transform:scale(1.08)
  }
}

@keyframes confetti{
  0%{
    transform:translateY(-20px) rotate(0)
  }

  100%{
    transform:translateY(360px) rotate(540deg)
  }
}

@keyframes gradientMove{
  0%,100%{
    background-position:0% 50%
  }

  50%{
    background-position:100% 50%
  }
}

@keyframes eq{
  0%,100%{
    height:8px
  }

  50%{
    height:26px
  }
}

@keyframes shine{
  from{
    transform:translateX(-100%)
  }

  to{
    transform:translateX(220%)
  }
}

@keyframes slideInTop{
  from{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(-14px) scale(.98)
  }

  to{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0) scale(1)
  }
}

@keyframes liveGlow{
  0%,100%{
    box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(220,38,38,.55)
  }

  50%{
    box-shadow:0 0 22px 4px rgba(220,38,38,.45)
  }
}

@keyframes toastIn{
  from{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(18px)
  }

  to{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0)
  }
}

.animate-slide-in{
  animation:slideInTop .45s ease both;
}

.animate-live-glow{
  animation:liveGlow 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-toast-in{
  animation:toastIn .35s ease both;
}

.animate-marquee{
  animation:marquee 26s linear infinite;
}

.animate-float{
  animation:floatY 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-ball{
  animation:ballSpin 7s linear infinite;
}

.animate-bounce-ball{
  animation:ballBounce 1.35s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-pulse-dot{
  animation:pulseDot 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-crowd{
  animation:crowd 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-gradient{
  background-size:220% 220%;
  animation:gradientMove 8s ease infinite;
}

.shine{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}

.shine:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  width:45%;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.18),transparent);
  animation:shine 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

input,select,textarea,button{
  font:inherit;
}

button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible{
  outline:3px solid var(--gold);
  outline-offset:2px;
}

.range{
  accent-color:var(--neon);
}

.seam{
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 0 8px, rgba(255,255,255,.85) 9px 11px, transparent 12px 20px);
}

}

  .lg\:grid-cols-4{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-\[1\.2fr_\.8fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1.2fr .8fr;
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-\[1\.55fr_\.85fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1.55fr .85fr;
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-\[1fr_1\.2fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr;
  }

  .lg\:py-10{
    padding-top: 2.5rem;
    padding-bottom: 2.5rem;
  }
}

(() => {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const rawInset = params.get('top_inset_px');
  const parsedInset = rawInset !== null && /^\d+$/.test(rawInset)
    ? Number(rawInset)
    : 0;
  const topInset = params.get('has_top_banner') === '1'
    ? Math.min(parsedInset, 256)
    : 0;
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-top', `${topInset}px`);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${topInset}px`);

  function observeNavigation() {
    const root = document.getElementById('root');
    if (root === null) return;
    const observed = new Set();
    let scheduled = false;

    function syncScrollPadding() {
      const elements = new Set(root.querySelectorAll('[data-safe-area-sticky-top]'));
      for (const element of observed) {
        if (!elements.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.unobserve(element);
          observed.delete(element);
        }
      }
      for (const element of elements) {
        if (!observed.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.observe(element);
          observed.add(element);
        }
      }
      let padding = topInset;
      for (const element of elements) {
        const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
        if (style.position !== 'sticky' && style.position !== 'fixed') continue;
        const top = Number.parseFloat(style.top);
        if (Number.isFinite(top)) {
          padding = Math.max(padding, top + element.getBoundingClientRect().height);
        }
      }
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${Math.ceil(padding)}px`,
      );
    }

    function scheduleUpdate() {
      if (scheduled) return;
      scheduled = true;
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        scheduled = false;
        syncScrollPadding();
      });
    }

    const mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(scheduleUpdate);
    mutationObserver.observe(root, {
      attributeFilter: ['class', 'data-safe-area-sticky-top', 'hidden', 'style'],
      attributes: true,
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,

// limit, this page answers the next writes itself with the same rejection.

// write goes to the network per backoff window. A new record that the API

1. Make replaced elements `display: block` by default. (https://github.com/mozdevs/cssremedy/issues/14)
2. Add `vertical-align: middle` to align replaced elements more sensibly by default. (https://github.com/jensimmons/cssremedy/issues/14#issuecomment-634934210)

.shadow-\[0_0_28px_rgba\(220\2c 38\2c 38\2c \.55\)\]{
  --tw-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(220,38,38,.55);
  --tw-shadow-colored: 0 0 28px var(--tw-shadow-color);
  box-shadow: var(--tw-ring-offset-shadow, 0 0 #0000), var(--tw-ring-shadow, 0 0 #0000), var(--tw-shadow);
}

.shadow-\[0_0_30px_rgba\(255\2c 255\2c 255\2c \.5\)\]{
  --tw-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  --tw-shadow-colored: 0 0 30px var(--tw-shadow-color);
  box-shadow: var(--tw-ring-offset-shadow, 0 0 #0000), var(--tw-ring-shadow, 0 0 #0000), var(--tw-shadow);
}

.shadow-\[0_0_35px_rgba\(220\2c 38\2c 38\2c \.55\)\]{
  --tw-shadow: 0 0 35px rgba(220,38,38,.55);
  --tw-shadow-colored: 0 0 35px var(--tw-shadow-color);
  box-shadow: var(--tw-ring-offset-shadow, 0 0 #0000), var(--tw-ring-shadow, 0 0 #0000), var(--tw-shadow);
}

.outline-none{
  outline: 2px solid transparent;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.ring{
  --tw-ring-offset-shadow: var(--tw-ring-inset) 0 0 0 var(--tw-ring-offset-width) var(--tw-ring-offset-color);
  --tw-ring-shadow: var(--tw-ring-inset) 0 0 0 calc(3px + var(--tw-ring-offset-width)) var(--tw-ring-color);
  box-shadow: var(--tw-ring-offset-shadow), var(--tw-ring-shadow), var(--tw-shadow, 0 0 #0000);
}

.filter{
  filter: var(--tw-blur) var(--tw-brightness) var(--tw-contrast) var(--tw-grayscale) var(--tw-hue-rotate) var(--tw-invert) var(--tw-saturate) var(--tw-sepia) var(--tw-drop-shadow);
}

.backdrop-blur-xl{
  --tw-backdrop-blur: blur(24px);
  backdrop-filter: var(--tw-backdrop-blur) var(--tw-backdrop-brightness) var(--tw-backdrop-contrast) var(--tw-backdrop-grayscale) var(--tw-backdrop-hue-rotate) var(--tw-backdrop-invert) var(--tw-backdrop-opacity) var(--tw-backdrop-saturate) var(--tw-backdrop-sepia);
}

.transition-all{
  transition-property: all;
  transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  transition-duration: 150ms;
}

.transition-colors{
  transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, text-decoration-color, fill, stroke;
  transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  transition-duration: 150ms;
}

.duration-700{
  transition-duration: 700ms;
}

.ease-in-out{
  transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

:root{
  --bg:#04120A;
  --surface:#071E12;
  --surface-2:#0A2A1A;
  --line:#1D4A30;
  --neon:#00FF88;
  --gold:#FFC107;
  --blue:#38BDF8;
  --text:#F2FFF7;
  --muted:#A9C6B4;
  --card:rgba(10,38,24,.82);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root{
    --bg:#030F08;
    --surface:#061B10;
  }
}

*{
  box-sizing:border-box;
}

html{
  scroll-behavior:smooth;
}

body{
  margin:0;
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif;
}

.font-display{
  font-family:'Oswald','Archivo',sans-serif;
}

.glass{
  background:var(--card);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border:1px solid rgba(0,255,136,.22);
}

.glow{
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,255,136,.2), 0 18px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 0 42px rgba(0,255,136,.12);
}

.text-stroke{
  -webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(0,255,136,.55);
  color:transparent;
}

.tilt{
  transition:transform .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease;
  transform-style:preserve-3d;
}

.tilt:hover{
  transform:translateY(-7px) rotateX(4deg) rotateY(-4deg);
  box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 0 0 35px rgba(0,255,136,.18);
}

@keyframes marquee{
  from{
    transform:translateX(0)
  }

  to{
    transform:translateX(-50%)
  }
}

@keyframes floatY{
  0%,100%{
    transform:translateY(0) rotate(-3deg)
  }

  50%{
    transform:translateY(-16px) rotate(4deg)
  }
}

@keyframes ballSpin{
  from{
    transform:rotate(0deg)
  }

  to{
    transform:rotate(360deg)
  }
}

@keyframes ballBounce{
  0%,100%{
    transform:translateY(0) scale(1.05,.95)
  }

  50%{
    transform:translateY(-58px) scale(.96,1.04)
  }
}

@keyframes pulseDot{
  0%,100%{
    transform:scale(1);
    opacity:1
  }

  50%{
    transform:scale(1.7);
    opacity:.35
  }
}

@keyframes crowd{
  0%,100%{
    opacity:.25;
    transform:scale(1)
  }

  50%{
    opacity:.65;
    transform:scale(1.08)
  }
}

@keyframes confetti{
  0%{
    transform:translateY(-20px) rotate(0)
  }

  100%{
    transform:translateY(360px) rotate(540deg)
  }
}

@keyframes gradientMove{
  0%,100%{
    background-position:0% 50%
  }

  50%{
    background-position:100% 50%
  }
}

@keyframes eq{
  0%,100%{
    height:8px
  }

  50%{
    height:26px
  }
}

@keyframes shine{
  from{
    transform:translateX(-100%)
  }

  to{
    transform:translateX(220%)
  }
}

@keyframes slideInTop{
  from{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(-14px) scale(.98)
  }

  to{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0) scale(1)
  }
}

@keyframes liveGlow{
  0%,100%{
    box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(220,38,38,.55)
  }

  50%{
    box-shadow:0 0 22px 4px rgba(220,38,38,.45)
  }
}

@keyframes toastIn{
  from{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(18px)
  }

  to{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0)
  }
}

.animate-slide-in{
  animation:slideInTop .45s ease both;
}

.animate-live-glow{
  animation:liveGlow 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-toast-in{
  animation:toastIn .35s ease both;
}

.animate-marquee{
  animation:marquee 26s linear infinite;
}

.animate-float{
  animation:floatY 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-ball{
  animation:ballSpin 7s linear infinite;
}

.animate-bounce-ball{
  animation:ballBounce 1.35s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-pulse-dot{
  animation:pulseDot 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-crowd{
  animation:crowd 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-gradient{
  background-size:220% 220%;
  animation:gradientMove 8s ease infinite;
}

.shine{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}

.shine:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  width:45%;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.18),transparent);
  animation:shine 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

input,select,textarea,button{
  font:inherit;
}

button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible{
  outline:3px solid var(--gold);
  outline-offset:2px;
}

.range{
  accent-color:var(--neon);
}

.seam{
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 0 8px, rgba(255,255,255,.85) 9px 11px, transparent 12px 20px);
}

.placeholder\:text-white\/40::-moz-placeholder{
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.4);
}

.placeholder\:text-white\/40::placeholder{
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.4);
}

.hover\:scale-105:hover{
  --tw-scale-x: 1.05;
  --tw-scale-y: 1.05;
  transform: translate(var(--tw-translate-x), var(--tw-translate-y)) rotate(var(--tw-rotate)) skewX(var(--tw-skew-x)) skewY(var(--tw-skew-y)) scaleX(var(--tw-scale-x)) scaleY(var(--tw-scale-y));
}

.hover\:scale-110:hover{
  --tw-scale-x: 1.1;
  --tw-scale-y: 1.1;
  transform: translate(var(--tw-translate-x), var(--tw-translate-y)) rotate(var(--tw-rotate)) skewX(var(--tw-skew-x)) skewY(var(--tw-skew-y)) scaleX(var(--tw-scale-x)) scaleY(var(--tw-scale-y));
}

.hover\:border-\[\#00FF88\]:hover{
  --tw-border-opacity: 1;
  border-color: rgb(0 255 136 / var(--tw-border-opacity, 1));
}

.hover\:border-red-400:hover{
  --tw-border-opacity: 1;
  border-color: rgb(248 113 113 / var(--tw-border-opacity, 1));
}

.hover\:bg-white\/10:hover{
  background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1);
}

.hover\:bg-white\/5:hover{
  background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05);
}

.hover\:text-\[\#00FF88\]:hover{
  --tw-text-opacity: 1;
  color: rgb(0 255 136 / var(--tw-text-opacity, 1));
}

.disabled\:opacity-60:disabled{
  opacity: 0.6;
}

@media (min-width: 640px){
  .sm\:order-2{
    order: 2;
  }

  .sm\:order-3{
    order: 3;
  }

  .sm\:ml-auto{
    margin-left: auto;
  }

  .sm\:block{
    display: block;
  }

  .sm\:w-auto{
    width: auto;
  }

  .sm\:flex-1{
    flex: 1 1 0%;
  }

  .sm\:grid-cols-2{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .sm\:grid-cols-\[1fr_2fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
  }

  .sm\:grid-cols-\[3rem_1fr_5rem_6rem_5rem\]{
    grid-template-columns: 3rem 1fr 5rem 6rem 5rem;
  }

  .sm\:flex-row{
    flex-direction: row;
  }

  .sm\:flex-wrap{
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .sm\:items-center{
    align-items: center;
  }

  .sm\:justify-center{
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .sm\:gap-2{
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:self-auto{
    align-self: auto;
  }

  .sm\:p-10{
    padding: 2.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:p-6{
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:px-3{
    padding-left: 0.75rem;
    padding-right: 0.75rem;
  }

  .sm\:px-5{
    padding-left: 1.25rem;
    padding-right: 1.25rem;
  }

  .sm\:px-6{
    padding-left: 1.5rem;
    padding-right: 1.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-2xl{
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    line-height: 2rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-3xl{
    font-size: 1.875rem;
    line-height: 2.25rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-5xl{
    font-size: 3rem;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .sm\:text-\[13px\]{
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .sm\:text-base{
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-sm{
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1.25rem;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 768px){
  .md\:block{
    display: block;
  }

  .md\:flex{
    display: flex;
  }

  .md\:hidden{
    display: none;
  }

  .md\:grid-cols-3{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (min-width: 1024px){
  .lg\:grid-cols-3{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-4{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-\[1\.2fr_\.8fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1.2fr .8fr;
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-\[1\.55fr_\.85fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1.55fr .85fr;
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-\[1fr_1\.2fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr;
  }

  .lg\:py-10{
    padding-top: 2.5rem;
    padding-bottom: 2.5rem;
  }
}

(() => {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const rawInset = params.get('top_inset_px');
  const parsedInset = rawInset !== null && /^\d+$/.test(rawInset)
    ? Number(rawInset)
    : 0;
  const topInset = params.get('has_top_banner') === '1'
    ? Math.min(parsedInset, 256)
    : 0;
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-top', `${topInset}px`);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${topInset}px`);

  function observeNavigation() {
    const root = document.getElementById('root');
    if (root === null) return;
    const observed = new Set();
    let scheduled = false;

    function syncScrollPadding() {
      const elements = new Set(root.querySelectorAll('[data-safe-area-sticky-top]'));
      for (const element of observed) {
        if (!elements.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.unobserve(element);
          observed.delete(element);
        }
      }
      for (const element of elements) {
        if (!observed.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.observe(element);
          observed.add(element);
        }
      }
      let padding = topInset;
      for (const element of elements) {
        const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
        if (style.position !== 'sticky' && style.position !== 'fixed') continue;
        const top = Number.parseFloat(style.top);
        if (Number.isFinite(top)) {
          padding = Math.max(padding, top + element.getBoundingClientRect().height);
        }
      }
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${Math.ceil(padding)}px`,
      );
    }

    function scheduleUpdate() {
      if (scheduled) return;
      scheduled = true;
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        scheduled = false;
        syncScrollPadding();
      });
    }

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(scheduleUpdate);
    const mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(scheduleUpdate);
    mutationObserver.observe(root, {
      attributeFilter: ['class', 'data-safe-area-sticky-top', 'hidden', 'style'],
      attributes: true,
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
    });

    scheduleUpdate();

:root{
  --bg:#04120A;
  --surface:#071E12;
  --surface-2:#0A2A1A;
  --line:#1D4A30;
  --neon:#00FF88;
  --gold:#FFC107;
  --blue:#38BDF8;
  --text:#F2FFF7;
  --muted:#A9C6B4;
  --card:rgba(10,38,24,.82);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root{
    --bg:#030F08;
    --surface:#061B10;
  }
}

*{
  box-sizing:border-box;
}

html{
  scroll-behavior:smooth;
}

body{
  margin:0;
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif;
}

.font-display{
  font-family:'Oswald','Archivo',sans-serif;
}

.glass{
  background:var(--card);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border:1px solid rgba(0,255,136,.22);
}

.glow{
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,255,136,.2), 0 18px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 0 42px rgba(0,255,136,.12);
}

.text-stroke{
  -webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(0,255,136,.55);
  color:transparent;
}

.tilt{
  transition:transform .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease;
  transform-style:preserve-3d;
}

.tilt:hover{
  transform:translateY(-7px) rotateX(4deg) rotateY(-4deg);
  box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 0 0 35px rgba(0,255,136,.18);
}

@keyframes marquee{
  from{
    transform:translateX(0)
  }

  to{
    transform:translateX(-50%)
  }
}

@keyframes floatY{
  0%,100%{
    transform:translateY(0) rotate(-3deg)
  }

  50%{
    transform:translateY(-16px) rotate(4deg)
  }
}

@keyframes ballSpin{
  from{
    transform:rotate(0deg)
  }

  to{
    transform:rotate(360deg)
  }
}

@keyframes ballBounce{
  0%,100%{
    transform:translateY(0) scale(1.05,.95)
  }

  50%{
    transform:translateY(-58px) scale(.96,1.04)
  }
}

@keyframes pulseDot{
  0%,100%{
    transform:scale(1);
    opacity:1
  }

  50%{
    transform:scale(1.7);
    opacity:.35
  }
}

@keyframes crowd{
  0%,100%{
    opacity:.25;
    transform:scale(1)
  }

  50%{
    opacity:.65;
    transform:scale(1.08)
  }
}

@keyframes confetti{
  0%{
    transform:translateY(-20px) rotate(0)
  }

  100%{
    transform:translateY(360px) rotate(540deg)
  }
}

@keyframes gradientMove{
  0%,100%{
    background-position:0% 50%
  }

  50%{
    background-position:100% 50%
  }
}

@keyframes eq{
  0%,100%{
    height:8px
  }

  50%{
    height:26px
  }
}

@keyframes shine{
  from{
    transform:translateX(-100%)
  }

  to{
    transform:translateX(220%)
  }
}

@keyframes slideInTop{
  from{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(-14px) scale(.98)
  }

  to{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0) scale(1)
  }
}

@keyframes liveGlow{
  0%,100%{
    box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(220,38,38,.55)
  }

  50%{
    box-shadow:0 0 22px 4px rgba(220,38,38,.45)
  }
}

@keyframes toastIn{
  from{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(18px)
  }

  to{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0)
  }
}

.animate-slide-in{
  animation:slideInTop .45s ease both;
}

.animate-live-glow{
  animation:liveGlow 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-toast-in{
  animation:toastIn .35s ease both;
}

.animate-marquee{
  animation:marquee 26s linear infinite;
}

.animate-float{
  animation:floatY 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-ball{
  animation:ballSpin 7s linear infinite;
}

.animate-bounce-ball{
  animation:ballBounce 1.35s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-pulse-dot{
  animation:pulseDot 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-crowd{
  animation:crowd 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-gradient{
  background-size:220% 220%;
  animation:gradientMove 8s ease infinite;
}

.shine{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}

.shine:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  width:45%;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.18),transparent);
  animation:shine 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

input,select,textarea,button{
  font:inherit;
}

button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible{
  outline:3px solid var(--gold);
  outline-offset:2px;
}

.range{
  accent-color:var(--neon);
}

}

(() => {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const rawInset = params.get('top_inset_px');
  const parsedInset = rawInset !== null && /^\d+$/.test(rawInset)
    ? Number(rawInset)
    : 0;
  const topInset = params.get('has_top_banner') === '1'
    ? Math.min(parsedInset, 256)
    : 0;
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-top', `${topInset}px`);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${topInset}px`);

  function observeNavigation() {
    const root = document.getElementById('root');
    if (root === null) return;
    const observed = new Set();
    let scheduled = false;

    function syncScrollPadding() {
      const elements = new Set(root.querySelectorAll('[data-safe-area-sticky-top]'));
      for (const element of observed) {
        if (!elements.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.unobserve(element);
          observed.delete(element);
        }
      }
      for (const element of elements) {
        if (!observed.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.observe(element);
          observed.add(element);
        }
      }
      let padding = topInset;
      for (const element of elements) {
        const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
        if (style.position !== 'sticky' && style.position !== 'fixed') continue;
        const top = Number.parseFloat(style.top);
        if (Number.isFinite(top)) {
          padding = Math.max(padding, top + element.getBoundingClientRect().height);
        }
      }
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${Math.ceil(padding)}px`,
      );
    }

    function scheduleUpdate() {
      if (scheduled) return;
      scheduled = true;
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        scheduled = false;
        syncScrollPadding();
      });
    }

    const mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(scheduleUpdate);
    mutationObserver.observe(root, {
      attributeFilter: ['class', 'data-safe-area-sticky-top', 'hidden', 'style'],
      attributes: true,
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,

// limit, this page answers the next writes itself with the same rejection.

// write goes to the network per backoff window. A new record that the API

1. Make replaced elements `display: block` by default. (https://github.com/mozdevs/cssremedy/issues/14)
2. Add `vertical-align: middle` to align replaced elements more sensibly by default. (https://github.com/jensimmons/cssremedy/issues/14#issuecomment-634934210)

.shadow-\[0_0_28px_rgba\(220\2c 38\2c 38\2c \.55\)\]{
  --tw-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(220,38,38,.55);
  --tw-shadow-colored: 0 0 28px var(--tw-shadow-color);
  box-shadow: var(--tw-ring-offset-shadow, 0 0 #0000), var(--tw-ring-shadow, 0 0 #0000), var(--tw-shadow);
}

.shadow-\[0_0_30px_rgba\(255\2c 255\2c 255\2c \.5\)\]{
  --tw-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  --tw-shadow-colored: 0 0 30px var(--tw-shadow-color);
  box-shadow: var(--tw-ring-offset-shadow, 0 0 #0000), var(--tw-ring-shadow, 0 0 #0000), var(--tw-shadow);
}

.shadow-\[0_0_35px_rgba\(220\2c 38\2c 38\2c \.55\)\]{
  --tw-shadow: 0 0 35px rgba(220,38,38,.55);
  --tw-shadow-colored: 0 0 35px var(--tw-shadow-color);
  box-shadow: var(--tw-ring-offset-shadow, 0 0 #0000), var(--tw-ring-shadow, 0 0 #0000), var(--tw-shadow);
}

.outline-none{
  outline: 2px solid transparent;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.ring{
  --tw-ring-offset-shadow: var(--tw-ring-inset) 0 0 0 var(--tw-ring-offset-width) var(--tw-ring-offset-color);
  --tw-ring-shadow: var(--tw-ring-inset) 0 0 0 calc(3px + var(--tw-ring-offset-width)) var(--tw-ring-color);
  box-shadow: var(--tw-ring-offset-shadow), var(--tw-ring-shadow), var(--tw-shadow, 0 0 #0000);
}

.filter{
  filter: var(--tw-blur) var(--tw-brightness) var(--tw-contrast) var(--tw-grayscale) var(--tw-hue-rotate) var(--tw-invert) var(--tw-saturate) var(--tw-sepia) var(--tw-drop-shadow);
}

.backdrop-blur-xl{
  --tw-backdrop-blur: blur(24px);
  backdrop-filter: var(--tw-backdrop-blur) var(--tw-backdrop-brightness) var(--tw-backdrop-contrast) var(--tw-backdrop-grayscale) var(--tw-backdrop-hue-rotate) var(--tw-backdrop-invert) var(--tw-backdrop-opacity) var(--tw-backdrop-saturate) var(--tw-backdrop-sepia);
}

.transition-all{
  transition-property: all;
  transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  transition-duration: 150ms;
}

.transition-colors{
  transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, text-decoration-color, fill, stroke;
  transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  transition-duration: 150ms;
}

.duration-700{
  transition-duration: 700ms;
}

.ease-in-out{
  transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

:root{
  --bg:#04120A;
  --surface:#071E12;
  --surface-2:#0A2A1A;
  --line:#1D4A30;
  --neon:#00FF88;
  --gold:#FFC107;
  --blue:#38BDF8;
  --text:#F2FFF7;
  --muted:#A9C6B4;
  --card:rgba(10,38,24,.82);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root{
    --bg:#030F08;
    --surface:#061B10;
  }
}

*{
  box-sizing:border-box;
}

html{
  scroll-behavior:smooth;
}

body{
  margin:0;
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif;
}

.font-display{
  font-family:'Oswald','Archivo',sans-serif;
}

.glass{
  background:var(--card);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border:1px solid rgba(0,255,136,.22);
}

.glow{
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,255,136,.2), 0 18px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 0 42px rgba(0,255,136,.12);
}

.text-stroke{
  -webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(0,255,136,.55);
  color:transparent;
}

.tilt{
  transition:transform .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease;
  transform-style:preserve-3d;
}

.tilt:hover{
  transform:translateY(-7px) rotateX(4deg) rotateY(-4deg);
  box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 0 0 35px rgba(0,255,136,.18);
}

@keyframes marquee{
  from{
    transform:translateX(0)
  }

  to{
    transform:translateX(-50%)
  }
}

@keyframes floatY{
  0%,100%{
    transform:translateY(0) rotate(-3deg)
  }

  50%{
    transform:translateY(-16px) rotate(4deg)
  }
}

@keyframes ballSpin{
  from{
    transform:rotate(0deg)
  }

  to{
    transform:rotate(360deg)
  }
}

@keyframes ballBounce{
  0%,100%{
    transform:translateY(0) scale(1.05,.95)
  }

  50%{
    transform:translateY(-58px) scale(.96,1.04)
  }
}

@keyframes pulseDot{
  0%,100%{
    transform:scale(1);
    opacity:1
  }

  50%{
    transform:scale(1.7);
    opacity:.35
  }
}

@keyframes crowd{
  0%,100%{
    opacity:.25;
    transform:scale(1)
  }

  50%{
    opacity:.65;
    transform:scale(1.08)
  }
}

@keyframes confetti{
  0%{
    transform:translateY(-20px) rotate(0)
  }

  100%{
    transform:translateY(360px) rotate(540deg)
  }
}

@keyframes gradientMove{
  0%,100%{
    background-position:0% 50%
  }

  50%{
    background-position:100% 50%
  }
}

@keyframes eq{
  0%,100%{
    height:8px
  }

  50%{
    height:26px
  }
}

@keyframes shine{
  from{
    transform:translateX(-100%)
  }

  to{
    transform:translateX(220%)
  }
}

@keyframes slideInTop{
  from{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(-14px) scale(.98)
  }

  to{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0) scale(1)
  }
}

@keyframes liveGlow{
  0%,100%{
    box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(220,38,38,.55)
  }

  50%{
    box-shadow:0 0 22px 4px rgba(220,38,38,.45)
  }
}

@keyframes toastIn{
  from{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(18px)
  }

  to{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0)
  }
}

.animate-slide-in{
  animation:slideInTop .45s ease both;
}

.animate-live-glow{
  animation:liveGlow 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-toast-in{
  animation:toastIn .35s ease both;
}

.animate-marquee{
  animation:marquee 26s linear infinite;
}

.animate-float{
  animation:floatY 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-ball{
  animation:ballSpin 7s linear infinite;
}

.animate-bounce-ball{
  animation:ballBounce 1.35s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-pulse-dot{
  animation:pulseDot 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-crowd{
  animation:crowd 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-gradient{
  background-size:220% 220%;
  animation:gradientMove 8s ease infinite;
}

.shine{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}

.shine:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  width:45%;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.18),transparent);
  animation:shine 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

input,select,textarea,button{
  font:inherit;
}

button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible{
  outline:3px solid var(--gold);
  outline-offset:2px;
}

.range{
  accent-color:var(--neon);
}

.seam{
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 0 8px, rgba(255,255,255,.85) 9px 11px, transparent 12px 20px);
}

.placeholder\:text-white\/40::-moz-placeholder{
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.4);
}

.placeholder\:text-white\/40::placeholder{
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.4);
}

.hover\:scale-105:hover{
  --tw-scale-x: 1.05;
  --tw-scale-y: 1.05;
  transform: translate(var(--tw-translate-x), var(--tw-translate-y)) rotate(var(--tw-rotate)) skewX(var(--tw-skew-x)) skewY(var(--tw-skew-y)) scaleX(var(--tw-scale-x)) scaleY(var(--tw-scale-y));
}

.hover\:scale-110:hover{
  --tw-scale-x: 1.1;
  --tw-scale-y: 1.1;
  transform: translate(var(--tw-translate-x), var(--tw-translate-y)) rotate(var(--tw-rotate)) skewX(var(--tw-skew-x)) skewY(var(--tw-skew-y)) scaleX(var(--tw-scale-x)) scaleY(var(--tw-scale-y));
}

.hover\:border-\[\#00FF88\]:hover{
  --tw-border-opacity: 1;
  border-color: rgb(0 255 136 / var(--tw-border-opacity, 1));
}

.hover\:border-red-400:hover{
  --tw-border-opacity: 1;
  border-color: rgb(248 113 113 / var(--tw-border-opacity, 1));
}

.hover\:bg-white\/10:hover{
  background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1);
}

.hover\:bg-white\/5:hover{
  background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05);
}

.hover\:text-\[\#00FF88\]:hover{
  --tw-text-opacity: 1;
  color: rgb(0 255 136 / var(--tw-text-opacity, 1));
}

.disabled\:opacity-60:disabled{
  opacity: 0.6;
}

@media (min-width: 640px){
  .sm\:order-2{
    order: 2;
  }

  .sm\:order-3{
    order: 3;
  }

  .sm\:ml-auto{
    margin-left: auto;
  }

  .sm\:block{
    display: block;
  }

  .sm\:w-auto{
    width: auto;
  }

  .sm\:flex-1{
    flex: 1 1 0%;
  }

  .sm\:grid-cols-2{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .sm\:grid-cols-\[1fr_2fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
  }

  .sm\:grid-cols-\[3rem_1fr_5rem_6rem_5rem\]{
    grid-template-columns: 3rem 1fr 5rem 6rem 5rem;
  }

  .sm\:flex-row{
    flex-direction: row;
  }

  .sm\:flex-wrap{
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .sm\:items-center{
    align-items: center;
  }

  .sm\:justify-center{
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .sm\:gap-2{
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:self-auto{
    align-self: auto;
  }

  .sm\:p-10{
    padding: 2.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:p-6{
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:px-3{
    padding-left: 0.75rem;
    padding-right: 0.75rem;
  }

  .sm\:px-5{
    padding-left: 1.25rem;
    padding-right: 1.25rem;
  }

  .sm\:px-6{
    padding-left: 1.5rem;
    padding-right: 1.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-2xl{
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    line-height: 2rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-3xl{
    font-size: 1.875rem;
    line-height: 2.25rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-5xl{
    font-size: 3rem;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .sm\:text-\[13px\]{
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .sm\:text-base{
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.5rem;
  }

  .sm\:text-sm{
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1.25rem;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 768px){
  .md\:block{
    display: block;
  }

  .md\:flex{
    display: flex;
  }

  .md\:hidden{
    display: none;
  }

  .md\:grid-cols-3{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (min-width: 1024px){
  .lg\:grid-cols-3{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-4{
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-\[1\.2fr_\.8fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1.2fr .8fr;
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-\[1\.55fr_\.85fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1.55fr .85fr;
  }

  .lg\:grid-cols-\[1fr_1\.2fr\]{
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr;
  }

  .lg\:py-10{
    padding-top: 2.5rem;
    padding-bottom: 2.5rem;
  }
}

(() => {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const rawInset = params.get('top_inset_px');
  const parsedInset = rawInset !== null && /^\d+$/.test(rawInset)
    ? Number(rawInset)
    : 0;
  const topInset = params.get('has_top_banner') === '1'
    ? Math.min(parsedInset, 256)
    : 0;
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-top', `${topInset}px`);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${topInset}px`);

  function observeNavigation() {
    const root = document.getElementById('root');
    if (root === null) return;
    const observed = new Set();
    let scheduled = false;

    function syncScrollPadding() {
      const elements = new Set(root.querySelectorAll('[data-safe-area-sticky-top]'));
      for (const element of observed) {
        if (!elements.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.unobserve(element);
          observed.delete(element);
        }
      }
      for (const element of elements) {
        if (!observed.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.observe(element);
          observed.add(element);
        }
      }
      let padding = topInset;
      for (const element of elements) {
        const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
        if (style.position !== 'sticky' && style.position !== 'fixed') continue;
        const top = Number.parseFloat(style.top);
        if (Number.isFinite(top)) {
          padding = Math.max(padding, top + element.getBoundingClientRect().height);
        }
      }
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${Math.ceil(padding)}px`,
      );
    }

    function scheduleUpdate() {
      if (scheduled) return;
      scheduled = true;
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        scheduled = false;
        syncScrollPadding();
      });
    }

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(scheduleUpdate);
    const mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(scheduleUpdate);
    mutationObserver.observe(root, {
      attributeFilter: ['class', 'data-safe-area-sticky-top', 'hidden', 'style'],
      attributes: true,
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
    });

    scheduleUpdate();

:root{
  --bg:#04120A;
  --surface:#071E12;
  --surface-2:#0A2A1A;
  --line:#1D4A30;
  --neon:#00FF88;
  --gold:#FFC107;
  --blue:#38BDF8;
  --text:#F2FFF7;
  --muted:#A9C6B4;
  --card:rgba(10,38,24,.82);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root{
    --bg:#030F08;
    --surface:#061B10;
  }
}

*{
  box-sizing:border-box;
}

html{
  scroll-behavior:smooth;
}

body{
  margin:0;
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif;
}

.font-display{
  font-family:'Oswald','Archivo',sans-serif;
}

.glass{
  background:var(--card);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border:1px solid rgba(0,255,136,.22);
}

.glow{
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,255,136,.2), 0 18px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 0 42px rgba(0,255,136,.12);
}

.text-stroke{
  -webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(0,255,136,.55);
  color:transparent;
}

.tilt{
  transition:transform .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease;
  transform-style:preserve-3d;
}

.tilt:hover{
  transform:translateY(-7px) rotateX(4deg) rotateY(-4deg);
  box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 0 0 35px rgba(0,255,136,.18);
}

@keyframes marquee{
  from{
    transform:translateX(0)
  }

  to{
    transform:translateX(-50%)
  }
}

@keyframes floatY{
  0%,100%{
    transform:translateY(0) rotate(-3deg)
  }

  50%{
    transform:translateY(-16px) rotate(4deg)
  }
}

@keyframes ballSpin{
  from{
    transform:rotate(0deg)
  }

  to{
    transform:rotate(360deg)
  }
}

@keyframes ballBounce{
  0%,100%{
    transform:translateY(0) scale(1.05,.95)
  }

  50%{
    transform:translateY(-58px) scale(.96,1.04)
  }
}

@keyframes pulseDot{
  0%,100%{
    transform:scale(1);
    opacity:1
  }

  50%{
    transform:scale(1.7);
    opacity:.35
  }
}

@keyframes crowd{
  0%,100%{
    opacity:.25;
    transform:scale(1)
  }

  50%{
    opacity:.65;
    transform:scale(1.08)
  }
}

@keyframes confetti{
  0%{
    transform:translateY(-20px) rotate(0)
  }

  100%{
    transform:translateY(360px) rotate(540deg)
  }
}

@keyframes gradientMove{
  0%,100%{
    background-position:0% 50%
  }

  50%{
    background-position:100% 50%
  }
}

@keyframes eq{
  0%,100%{
    height:8px
  }

  50%{
    height:26px
  }
}

@keyframes shine{
  from{
    transform:translateX(-100%)
  }

  to{
    transform:translateX(220%)
  }
}

@keyframes slideInTop{
  from{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(-14px) scale(.98)
  }

  to{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0) scale(1)
  }
}

@keyframes liveGlow{
  0%,100%{
    box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(220,38,38,.55)
  }

  50%{
    box-shadow:0 0 22px 4px rgba(220,38,38,.45)
  }
}

@keyframes toastIn{
  from{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(18px)
  }

  to{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(0)
  }
}

.animate-slide-in{
  animation:slideInTop .45s ease both;
}

.animate-live-glow{
  animation:liveGlow 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-toast-in{
  animation:toastIn .35s ease both;
}

.animate-marquee{
  animation:marquee 26s linear infinite;
}

.animate-float{
  animation:floatY 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-ball{
  animation:ballSpin 7s linear infinite;
}

.animate-bounce-ball{
  animation:ballBounce 1.35s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-pulse-dot{
  animation:pulseDot 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-crowd{
  animation:crowd 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-gradient{
  background-size:220% 220%;
  animation:gradientMove 8s ease infinite;
}

.shine{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}

.shine:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  width:45%;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.18),transparent);
  animation:shine 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

input,select,textarea,button{
  font:inherit;
}

button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible{
  outline:3px solid var(--gold);
  outline-offset:2px;
}

.range{
  accent-color:var(--neon);
}

}

(() => {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const rawInset = params.get('top_inset_px');
  const parsedInset = rawInset !== null && /^\d+$/.test(rawInset)
    ? Number(rawInset)
    : 0;
  const topInset = params.get('has_top_banner') === '1'
    ? Math.min(parsedInset, 256)
    : 0;
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-top', `${topInset}px`);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${topInset}px`);

  function observeNavigation() {
    const root = document.getElementById('root');
    if (root === null) return;
    const observed = new Set();
    let scheduled = false;

    function syncScrollPadding() {
      const elements = new Set(root.querySelectorAll('[data-safe-area-sticky-top]'));
      for (const element of observed) {
        if (!elements.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.unobserve(element);
          observed.delete(element);
        }
      }
      for (const element of elements) {
        if (!observed.has(element)) {
          resizeObserver.observe(element);
          observed.add(element);
        }
      }
      let padding = topInset;
      for (const element of elements) {
        const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
        if (style.position !== 'sticky' && style.position !== 'fixed') continue;
        const top = Number.parseFloat(style.top);
        if (Number.isFinite(top)) {
          padding = Math.max(padding, top + element.getBoundingClientRect().height);
        }
      }
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--safe-area-scroll-padding-top', `${Math.ceil(padding)}px`,
      );
    }

    function scheduleUpdate() {
      if (scheduled) return;
      scheduled = true;
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        scheduled = false;
        syncScrollPadding();
      });
    }

    const mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(scheduleUpdate);
    mutationObserver.observe(root, {
      attributeFilter: ['class', 'data-safe-area-sticky-top', 'hidden', 'style'],
      attributes: true,
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,

// limit, this page answers the next writes itself with the same rejection.

// write goes to the network per backoff window. A new record that the API

1. Make replaced elements `display: block` by default. (https://github.com/mozdevs/cssremedy/issues/14)
2. Add `vertical-align: middle` to align replaced elements more sensibly by default. (https://github.com/jensimmons/cssremedy/issues/14#issuecomment-634934210)
